name: Note refactor
description: Moves the selected text into a new note and leaves a [[link]] in its place, or splits a note into one note per heading. Never overwrites a note.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Adds “Extract selection to a new note” and “Split note by headings”
Reads the selection or the headings of the open note
Puts the [[link]] in place of what moved
Checks which note names are taken
Tells you where the text went
Remembers the heading level to split at
